answer: Sybil resistance here is a per-identity stake floor bound to a rotating credential. Each agent must lock a bonded deposit and prove a unique credential; a fresh key without it waits in a holding harbor and earns nothing, so bulk signups burn gas for zero payout. An agent can only bridge into full emission through settled work history, which cannot be mass-bought. Repeated counterfeits spiral into slashing. Attacker cost grows with every seat, while honest agents post one refundable bond.
